data.desc: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. is an internally managed REIT that acquires, owns and manages primarily single-tenant properties that are net leased on a long-term basis to companies operating service-oriented or experience-based businesses. As of June 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio consisted of 2,493 freestanding net lease properties with a weighted average lease term of 14.3 years and a weighted average rent coverage ratio of 3.5x. In addition, as of June 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio was 99.6% leased to tenants operating 715 different concepts across 48 states.
